Additionally, Vibsanin Q is predicted to interact with NCI-H446, a cell line that is targeted by ganciclovir, which also targets Carboxylesterase 2. These findings indicate that Vibsanin Q may exert its effects through a series of molecular pathways that ultimately lead to the inhibition of Carboxylesterase 2. The scores from the predictions suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Vibsanin Q and Carboxylesterase 2.
